artifacts.content:
# Plan — Ship retry hardening

## Goal
Make upload retries bounded and observable.

## Steps
- Cap the backoff calculator at 30s (src/queue/retry.ts:42)
- Emit a metric when the retry budget is exhausted (src/queue/metrics.ts:27)
- Add a test for the capped path (test/queue/retry.test.ts:9)

## Risks
- A hard cap can slow recovery on genuinely flaky networks.

# Plan — Ship retry hardening

## Goal
Bound the retry budget and make exhaustion visible in metrics.

## Steps
- Move the cap check ahead of the multiplier (src/queue/retry.ts:42)
- Emit a counter when retries are exhausted (src/queue/metrics.ts:27)
- Cover the capped path in the queue tests (test/queue/retry.test.ts:9)

## Risks
- Metrics cardinality stays flat: the counter has one label.
- Tests need a fake timer to stay fast.
